newsitem.title: USA: Unitel Video closes Editel New York unit.
newsitem.headline: Unitel Video closes Editel New York unit.

text.p: Unitel Video Inc said on Tuesday it ended negotiations to sell its Editel New York film-to-tape transfer business and closed the facility, effective immediately.
The company said it plans to distribute some of its Editel New York equipment to other divisions and sell the rest in order to reduce long-term debt.
Editel Sound will be relocated to Unitel's Windsor division in the near future. The company said the editorial portion of Editel New York previously was merged into Unitel's other New York divisions.
Unitel Video also said it has completed the expansion of its Editel Los Angeles post-production and special effects facility.

"The completion of our restructuring and elimination of unprofitable operations allowed Unitel to commence its 1997 fiscal year on September 1 with strong earnings prospects," said chief executive Barry Knepper.
He said focus on the company's core mobile/studio production facilities and entertainment post-production operations will help the company return to profitability.
